name: biblioflix
description: Biblioflix — Plataforma de leitura digital por assinatura

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:render: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm run db:generate && npm run build
